content:
elaine-peopleops: Quick Q for ops folks  Planning the post-hackathon "Volunteer + Recognition" wrap next Fri. Two asks: 1) offer comp-time for volunteers (up to 4h) and 2) set panel for micro spot-awards. Can we finalize by Tue?
pete-culture: Love it. Comp-time sounds fair. Do we have a simple RSVP so we can track hours?
toni-hr: We can do comp-time but need manager pre-approval rows on the form. Also must track in payroll with a code.
diego-platform: I'll make a Google form template and include a manager approval checkbox. Will share link by EOD.
rachel-eng: I'm happy to sit on the awards panel. Prefer a short rubric: impact, initiative, collaboration.
kudos-bot: New nomination submitted by diego-platform "Priya kept the CI green during the hack day" :sparkles:
sam-recruiting: I can join the panel if you want another cross-team rep.
toni-hr: Panel size: 3-4 recommended. Recusal rule: if you nominated someone you must abstain for that nominee. I'll draft a one-liner for the form.
pete-culture: Timeline idea: Nom open Fri-Fri (one week), panel meets next Monday for 30m, winners announced Mon all-hands. Works?
elaine-peopleops: Sounds good. Budget: micro awards = $75 digital each x 6 = $450. Confirmed available from culture budget?
pete-culture: We have $500 leftover from Q4 events. Good to go.
diego-platform: Form draft: Name of nominee, short reason (max 200 chars), nominator name, manager approval toggle, comp-time hours requested (if volunteer).
rachel-eng: Will the comp-time be only for organized volunteers or also for ad-hoc helpers?
toni-hr: Comp-time limited to scheduled volunteer shifts (to keep tracking simple). Ad-hoc kudos go into spot-award pool.
elaine-peopleops: Action items: Diego (form + sheet), Toni (policy blurb + recusal note), Pete (announce comms + promo), Rachel/Sam (panel). Reply when done and I'll lock schedule.
sam-recruiting: I'll block 30m on Monday morning for the panel.
diego-platform: Form up: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1abc123 - sheet will auto-populate with a "manager_approved" column.
toni-hr: Draft policy blurb: "Managers must approve comp-time requests. Panel members must recuse when they are the nominator. Spot-awards are taxable per payroll guidance." Will send to finance.
pete-culture: I'll whip up a one-slide promo for the hackathon wrap and drop in #general tomorrow.
elaine-peopleops: Thanks all  Please add volunteer shift hours to the form so payroll can code them. If anyone else wants to join panel, shout here.
kudos-bot: Reminder set by kudos-bot "Nomination form closes in 7 days"
elaine-peopleops: Closing loop: panel confirmed (Rachel, Sam, Pete), form live, promos scheduled. Finalize by Tue noon.
